## Deskripsi
Right now, above your head, the universe is screaming — flashes of radio light so violent they can briefly outshine an entire galaxy, each lasting less than a blink. When I first learned that a single Fast Radio Burst can release as much energy as our Sun produces in days — from something the size of a city — I honestly had to sit down. In this episode of Cosmic Unknown, we chase the millisecond screams of deep space: the 2007 discovery hidden on a hard drive for six years, the repeater that screamed hundreds of times, the magnetar caught red-handed inside our own galaxy in 2020, and how these cosmic screams became our best tool for weighing the invisible universe.
